visual_logic.surface_detail: Glistening, hydrodynamic skin with a 'Sandy Tan' base and 'Dark Olive' dappled camouflage along the dorsal ridge; skin features subtle specular highlights to appear wet across the full horizontal flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom comparisons. Hero focus remains on the extraordinarily wide, robust front flippers flattened toward the camera plane, and the massive, deep-set lateral eye.
visual_logic.facial_expression: Observational and calm; a gentle, stylized smirk and a large, reflective pupil facing laterally to ensure cinematic appeal.

environment.water: Crystalline 'Turquoise' water with sharp caustic light patterns dancing across the animal's back and the white 'Plattenkalk' floor.
environment.biota: Submerged clusters of 'Ancestral Seagrass' and scattered ammonite shells are moved to the distant background layer to ensure the creature's lower edge remains completely unobstructed.

visual_logic.pose: The ichthyosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, cruising horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original resting pose is adjusted to a level, straight swimming path, allowing the snout, compact body, and deep tail fluke to stretch end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system. The short, thick front flippers must touch the bottom edge of the frame to satisfy grounding rules.

negative_constraints: No matte clay textures; no 'button' eyes; avoid 'chibi' or squat proportions; no sharp predatory aggression; no vertical tilt or angled perspective—maintain a clean, measurable profile layout.
